title: apps.manifest.update in CI fails with token_expired once the config token is 12 hours old
symptoms: missing_scope when the token lacks app_configurations:write
Deploy pipeline worked yesterday and fails today without changes
cause: Manifest methods need an app configuration token, not a bot or user token, and config tokens expire 12 hours after they are generated. Each one comes with a refresh token that must be rotated through tooling.tokens.rotate.
fix: Store the config refresh token as a CI secret, rotate it at the start of every run, and save the new refresh token the call returns.
affected: Slack app manifest APIs (apps.manifest.create, update, validate), as of 2026-10
